Audio Overload SDK 1.4.8 as modified by the DeaDBeeF project (reentrant engines),
from https://github.com/DeaDBeeF-Player/deadbeef/tree/master/plugins/psf/aosdk

Chippy's change: psfmain.c no longer includes DeaDBeeF's headers; ao_get_lib
is provided by crates/aosdk-sys.
eng_psf.c, eng_psf2.c: the SPU no longer stops or fades at the tagged length; Chippy does.
eng_psf.c: PS-X EXEs are loaded whole (to the end of the decoded program, within RAM), not
  only the header's text size: rips put SEQ/VAB data past it (Mega Man X6's PSFs played silence).
psx.c: misaligned LH/LHU/LW/SH/SW use the aligned address instead of raising an address error,
  as Highly Experimental does; some rips' drivers make such accesses and hung in the exception.
eng_psf2.c, psx.h, psx_hw.c: PSF2's file systems and IOP heap pointer live in the CPU context
  instead of globals (two open songs shared them), the heap starts over on restart (each seek back
  allocated further up until it ran off the end of RAM), ELF sections and file reads that would
  land past the end of RAM are refused or cut short, and a failed start frees what it allocated.
psx.c: a jump in a branch's delay slot is ignored (the branch wins), as Final Fantasy X's patched
  driver needs: it loops with "b loop; jr ra", which returned and leaked the stack.
psx_hw.c: the IOP debug printing compiles again.
